observations.rationale: Analyst screening limits, not lender covenants or verified tax deductibility; test cash floors 500/750/1000 and leverage 2/3/4.
Prospective suspension of discretionary distributions and optional repayments. Existing declared obligations remain separate missing facts, not zeroed.
Future delivery/cost choices, not management cost guidance. Test run rates 0/100/125, one-year delay and doubled integration costs.

Projected 39-week bridge removes separately disclosed prior-year trade-WC movements before applying explicit closing-WC forecasts once; capex uses verified FY2024 seasonal calibration; not actual FY2025 interim balances. Lease principal must also map to the debt inventory. Public case applies separate cash-access assumptions. Supersedes frozen-balance diagnostic.

Explicit future cost decomposition and growth paths, not reported margins. Calibrate fixed expenses to verified operating EBITDA. Stress revenue and EBITDA margin; preliminary target Q1 deterioration makes flat extrapolation unreliable.

transaction.target_cash_rationale: Conservative future scenario choice; no upstream availability assumed

observations.rationale: Hypothetical future quote: 4.5% benchmark plus 250bp, 2% upfront, 75 transaction costs, stock reference 200. No claim these are committed financing or observed prices. Test rates +/-200bp, spreads +100/+200bp, fees 1/2/3%; historical redemption costs remain separate.
